name: XLA_ANALYTICAL_HDRS_B
description:
This table contains the header information for the analytical criteria. Since some
         analytical criteria are delivered as seeded data by the product teams, the name and the
         description are subjected to translation, so there are two tables for the analytical
         criteria.

columns.name: SUPPORTING_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Supporting reference unique identifier.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description:
Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of
                        products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Supporting reference short name.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description:
An abbreviated name that indicates the owner of a supporting
                        reference. Possible values are C: defined by the user, S: predefined by
                        Oracle.

columns.name: SUPP_REF_ORDER
columns.description: Order of the supporting reference

columns.name: BALANCING_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether balance will be maintained for the
                        specific supporting reference

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the supporting reference is
                        enabled.

columns.name: YEAR_END_CARRY_FORWARD_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicate if the application accounting definition is updated
                        since last exported

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description:
Version number generated automatically at the time of
                        export

columns.name: UPDATED_IN_ESSBASE
columns.description:
Indicates If the specific dimension is created for the
                        supporting reference in ESSBASE.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of
                        the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the session login associated to the
                        user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the user who last updated the
                        row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update
                        of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description:
Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is
                        incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at
                        the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has
                        updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description:
Source of seed data record. A value of
                        'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise,
                        specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description:
Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based
                        redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or
                        N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description:
Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based
                        redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or
                        N.
